action: Update the three-tier asset map draft to incorporate the RoboRide pricing collapse as a structural accelerant. The $0.12/mile price point with 8-minute residential coverage fundamentally changes the timeline assumptions in section two of the assessment — the 18-to-24 month window I had projected for meaningful ownership attrition now compresses to 9-to-12 months at the outside. I revise the tier-one urgency language, update the showroom revenue projection downward, and add a new sub-section on what the delivery partnership means for fleet and commercial vehicle service demand — that is actually a potential upside for the service lane if we position for it. I push a revised draft to Patricia today with a one-paragraph cover note flagging the timeline compression.
